content.reasoning: Three similar stitched womenswear lots of about 500 pieces sold at 66 to 72 percent off in 21 to 34 days, and this lot's Grade A condition and balanced size spread put it squarely among them. It has already sat 45 days at 70 percent off without selling, so a small step deeper, toward 72 to 75 percent, is reasonable if you want it gone faster. Stitched lawn is tied to the summer season, so the closer you get to its end, the more you should lean toward the top of this range. Three comparable sales is useful but still a small sample, so treat the timing as a rough guide.
